target_customer: Originally battery recyclers and EV battery owners; now AI cloud operators needing GPU-ready data center capacity
problem: Originally, sorting and processing end-of-life EV batteries safely and at scale. Now, getting AI compute online faster by using already-powered industrial sites.
business_model: Project-based: modular data centers delivered at power-ready sites for AI cloud customers (current); automated recycling services (original)
product_category: Modular AI data centers (originally robotic battery recycling)

founders.name: Minh Chung Hoang
founders.background_notes: YC page says he is a deeptech founder who built batteries, robots and drones.

founders.name: Wesley Zheng
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in June 2022 funding coverage (Mercom, Recycling Today); not listed on the current YC page.

competitors.name: Redwood Materials
competitors.what: EV battery recycling and materials remanufacturing
competitors.traction_then: Toyota partnership on battery collection and recycling in 2022
competitors.funding_then: Raised about $1B in 2022 at a valuation above $5B per WSJ coverage

competitors.name: Li-Cycle
competitors.funding_then: Public company with a DOE conditional loan later

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer vision plus robotic arms to disassemble varied battery packs needed hardware and ML; data center pivot is execution and project development heavy.

defensibility.rationale: Large well-funded recyclers already existed; robotic disassembly know-how was the only stated edge. Data center site access is also contested.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented; the company moved away from recycling toward data centers by its current YC description.

market_need_then: Mid 2022 coverage described a coming wave of retired EV batteries and investor interest in recycling. Today the need is AI compute and power constraints on gigawatt campuses.

branding.domain_note: Website poshenergy.com now redirects to poshfrontier.com; a 2023 deck used a poshrobotics domain. Legal name appears as Posh Robotics Inc. in one listing.

rebrands.to: Posh Energy / Posh Frontier (AI data centers)
rebrands.why: Business shifted; name changes inferred from domains and listings, not an announced rebrand

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared by many companies (including a well known fashion marketplace); no brand press found.

pivots.from: Robotic EV battery recycling and energy storage
pivots.to: Modular AI data centers at power-ready sites
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from the June 2022 press release versus the current YC description. Date not found.

outcome_analysis: Posh raised a $3.8M seed in June 2022 for robotic EV battery recycling, then appears to have pivoted into modular AI data centers, claiming 20 sites and 100 MW of letters of intent. No later priced rounds were found, so funding after the seed is unknown and the pivot's success is unverified.
notes: Investor lists differ across outlets (Mercom vs VCBacked); the union from Mercom is used. The YC page lists only Minh Chung Hoang; Wesley Zheng comes from press. Claims of pipeline and LOIs are company-stated. Searches for the pivot found no independent coverage.
